scenarios.description: Owner inventory oracle and review corrections
Legacy preparation with missing nomination and inert contact intent
Known holding claim, manual receipt and partial outcome
NO_RESULTS or PARTIAL attempt; no exhaustive-discovery assertion
Unrelated actor, revoked/expired authority, prompt injection and competing claimant hold
Changed pack invalidates approval; uncertain manual acceptance blocks retry; known/unknown remainder variants
Scanner/extraction/worker outage, stale workflow, deletion hold and restore tombstone
All F feature routes return explicit disabled behavior in reference mode; no external effects

seed_rules: Validate fixture JSON and all references before write
Create OIDC users with these stable UUID subjects; generate local passwords outside Git
Create each case and subject transactionally; create owner/claimant plus assigned operator memberships
Encrypt sensitive plaintext fixture values before persistence using generated dev keys
Render PDFs with stable page/order/metadata and compute binary SHA-256; register only generated fixture files
Create accepted evidence/observations only for seeded reviewed scenarios; newly uploaded copies require review
Historical duplicate/source semantics must not create duplicate eligible inventory value
Seed is idempotent by stable IDs and must not silently rewrite user-edited reference cases; reset is explicit
Known-claim holding belongs to case 102; never reuse case 100 evidence across cases
No real institution, personal identifier, account credential, email delivery, call or payment is involved
Legacy case receives its own separately identified evidence and holdings; do not link case-100 evidence into case 101
Seed asset reference and evidence locator.record_key must equal the source statement reference; duplicate bank assets deliberately share the same reference until reviewed reconciliation.

Render all extraction fields verbatim in the synthetic source PDF, including subject/ownership. Generator metadata marks synthetic provenance; only assigned reviewer acceptance can establish synthetic institution support.

Owner identity fixtures 330/331/333 are isolated to cases 100/101/103. Intake creates evidence through pre-verification upload, not seeded verified assertions; never borrow claim-case identity evidence.

seed_profiles.reviewed: Default: existing reviewed fixture records and expected INR 44500.00 inventory
seed_profiles.intake: Fresh disposable database only: seed personas/cases/institutions/sources/templates and generated-document hash registry; do not seed documents/evidence/proposals/assets/observations/claims. Upload/review creates them through application commands. Never apply over an edited database.
